environment: staging-a baseline versus immutable Cloudinary renditions

method.baseline: Next.js image optimizer with its existing q=75 policy and browser AVIF acceptance
method.candidate: Direct Cloudinary c_limit renditions using bounded WebP quality by media class
method.visualInspection: Original-resolution decoded comparisons for the East River photograph, Market Hotel crowd photograph, and Harry J. Epstein screenshot

performanceBudget.reason: Permit a small first-view byte tradeoff for a direct CDN hop and a 30-day immutable browser cache, while rejecting the multi-fold regressions produced by q_auto:best.

comparisons.note: q_30 was smaller than baseline but visibly softened interface text; q_35 retained the stronger documentary reading.

rejected.reason: 3.56 times the existing baseline; failed page-speed budget.
Smaller, but faces and the banner lost too much documentary detail.
Smaller, but interface text was visibly softer than the selected q_35 rendition.

decision: Keep q_30 for photographs and q_35 for screenshots on staging. Keep production and indexing gates open pending live staging observation.
